constraints.description: One TokenVerifier abstraction preserves HS256 and verifies RS256 JWKS tokens with per-URL multi-key caching and one refresh for an unknown kid.
The configured jwt_required value, issuer, and audience are enforced at middleware verification without anonymous downgrade.

validation.validation_method: Middleware assertions and sidecar stop-condition tests

constraints.description: Missing token, wrong secret, wrong audience, wrong issuer, unknown kid, and unreachable JWKS return 401; each assertion is paired with an observed-failing branch-inversion control and complete source restoration.

validation.validation_method: Exact no-header control, focused verification-error group, two branch inversions, complete retained-diff comparison, affected positive reruns, and captured error-level JWKS log

constraints.description: Tier 0 and strict OpenSpec validation pass, Tier 2 remains unrun, and no A1 change escapes the permitted surface or introduces a dependency or tenant concept.

validation.validation_method: Cargo check/clippy, OpenSpec strict validation, and diff inspection

global_rules: Use the A1 OpenSpec delta and EXECUTION-CONTRACT.md as acceptance authority because the project has no .kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md.
Report results only for server-full and transfer them to no other profile.
Do not run Tier 2 before all six readiness changes complete.
termination_conditions: The per-requirement verification record exists and includes the observed fail-closed negative control.
